deliveryModel: Outbound links only. Denny Games does not embed hosts or copy their builds, game data, or artwork.
verificationBoundary: All fifteen play URLs returned HTTP 200 to a direct GET request on reviewedAt. The five preceding additions received headless Chromium initial-page or canvas spot checks. Frozen Bubble 2: Fan Edition returned HTTP 429 to automated Chromium before rendering; its itch.io page identifies a released HTML5 build. This confirms URL reachability only for that entry; no complete game session, physical device, controller, or Tesla browser was tested.

entries.hostWrapperLicense: Not stated in the host README; not redistributed by Denny Games.
entries.notes: Host README identifies a Freedoom Phase 1 WAD, Chocolate Doom engine, corresponding source and a first load of about 35 MB. It says no proprietary id Software Doom WAD is included.

entries.projectLicense: OpenTTD core: GPL-2.0. Upstream documents OpenGFX GPL-2.0, OpenSFX CC BY-SA 3.0 and OpenMSX GPL-2.0 as free basesets; the linked host's selected data was not independently inspected.
entries.hostWrapperLicense: Not assessed; no host code or data is redistributed by Denny Games.
entries.notes: Independent browser host credited as Overgrown Studio. Host page exposes save import/export and online content controls. Original Transport Tycoon Deluxe data is not covered by OpenTTD's general permission.

entries.projectLicense: GPL-3.0-or-later code; game data has per-file terms and exceptions.
entries.hostWrapperLicense: Official project's web build; no build files are redistributed by Denny Games.
entries.notes: Official project browser page lists multiple versions. Version behavior, download size and controls can differ.

entries.hostWrapperLicense: Remote community server and web terminal; no server or client code is redistributed by Denny Games.
entries.notes: Remote play is hosted by NAO. The server controls account, session, save and privacy terms; users are directed to read its current guidance before signing in.

entries.projectLicense: Freeciv C server: GNU GPL; Freeciv-web browser client: GNU AGPL.
entries.hostWrapperLicense: Freeciv-web service based on the linked open-source project; the Denny Games listing does not redistribute its host code or game data.
entries.notes: The community site's action opens its single-player setup. The site links its own terms and privacy policy; account, session, browser-save behavior and multiplayer features follow that service. Freeciv has been in development since 1995.

entries.hostWrapperLicense: Browser-based Umoria source is GPL-3.0-or-later; Umoria.org says the maintainer permitted it to host the WebAssembly build. Denny Games redistributes no build files.
entries.notes: The project describes Moria as developed in 1983 and the first public Umoria release as 1987. Its browser build uses IndexedDB for saves scoped to each browser. Reachability was checked; the game session and save flow were not tested.

entries.projectLicense: MIT for the JavaScript Larn/Ularn port; original contributor attribution is retained upstream.
entries.hostWrapperLicense: MIT for the linked JavaScript port; Larn.org hosts the game and offers optional score/replay services. Denny Games redistributes no build files.
entries.notes: The Larn project source identifies the original Unix release as 1986 and says the browser port offers Larn and Ularn. The host advertises mobile support, weekly challenges, public scores and replays; none was tested here.

entries.projectLicense: Angband: GPL-2.0-or-later or the traditional Angband license; art assets have separate terms.
entries.hostWrapperLicense: Neo Angband is a community port, dual-licensed under GPLv2 or the traditional Angband license to match upstream; its bundled art has per-pack terms. Denny Games redistributes none of it.
entries.notes: Neo Angband describes itself as an unofficial community port, says its no-mod mode targets vanilla Angband, and stores saves in browser storage scoped to the host address. Denny Games did not verify parity, account behavior, mods, or device support.

entries.projectLicense: Most components are GPLv2-or-later; remaining components use compatible licenses.
entries.hostWrapperLicense: Community-run remote WebTiles server listed by the DCSS project. No server, client or game data is redistributed by Denny Games.
entries.notes: The official server directory lists crawl.nemelex.cards as a WebTiles server in Gyeonggi, South Korea and says accounts are not shared across servers. A GET returned 200; login, session, game and save behavior were not tested.

entries.projectLicense: MIT; collection page links the official license and puzzle source.
entries.hostWrapperLicense: Official collection author site; browser builds and assets are not redistributed by Denny Games.
entries.notes: The official collection includes many browser puzzles, each with its own controls. The web version does not save puzzle files; puzzle IDs or seeds can reproduce a board. A Fifteen puzzle page was opened as a reachability/render spot check, not played through.

entries.hostWrapperLicense: Official project WebAssembly build; no build files or game data are redistributed by Denny Games.
entries.notes: The official WebAssembly page rendered its game canvas. Account, community saves and privacy follow The Powder Toy host. No full simulation or save flow was tested.

entries.projectLicense: GNU GPL version 2; third-party components may have separate terms.
entries.hostWrapperLicense: Developer-hosted Emscripten online demo; the project describes it as reduced compared with downloads. Denny Games redistributes no demo files.
entries.notes: The official online page lists local saves, highscores, sound effects and additional modes among features in the downloadable version, and identifies Emscripten. The browser page and canvas rendered; no run or save flow was tested.

entries.projectLicense: Program GPL-3.0-or-later; source files and data have per-file GPL, Creative Commons and permissive terms.
entries.hostWrapperLicense: Afrikalan says its JavaScript/HTML5 adaptation is distributed under the GNU GPL; the version is not specified on its information page. Denny Games redistributes no browser files.
entries.notes: The host offers English-language selection and an on-screen answer keypad. The initial interface rendered in a 390px Chromium viewport; autoplay audio was blocked before a user gesture. No level or physical device was tested.

entries.hostWrapperLicense: Official host for the Rust/WebAssembly and WebGL game; community sharing is hosted there. Denny Games redistributes no game files or saves.
entries.notes: The repository identifies Rust via WebAssembly and WebGL, links the official host and describes creation sharing. The canvas rendered at 390px with no horizontal overflow; no creation or save flow was tested. A non-blocking host script error appeared in the console.

entries.projectLicense: GPL-2.0; third-party components have separate terms.
entries.hostWrapperLicense: The project links this itch.io page as its HTML5 browser build and describes the port as an independent rewrite, not affiliated with or endorsed by the original Frozen Bubble project.
entries.urlStatus: HTTP 200 (direct GET); automated Chromium navigation returned HTTP 429 before rendering
entries.notes: The itch.io page identifies a released HTML5 build of an independent rewrite inspired by the 2002 Frozen Bubble 2. Its source repository is GPL-2.0 and lists separate terms for third-party components. The page was not rendered in automated Chromium because the host returned 429; no game session, account, multiplayer, save, mobile or controller behavior was tested.
